text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the Nightingale postmortem. Summary: transient tenant isolation breaks seen during edge failover. Root causes look like (1) stale conntrack + NAT race on customer appliances and (2) rapid route re-announces from peering side causing short-lived asymmetric forwarding. Need clear owners for remediation, CI validation, monitoring, and customer coordination. Assigning items below. @diego @priya @emma please ack.

diego: I can take the route/peering side. Plan: add a 20s suppress window on re-announce for our peering agent, harden export filters to drop overlapping prefixes, and add a health-check gating rule before re-announce. Will open PR and short rollback doc. ETA: PR by Wed EOD.

priya: I'll own the on-prem audit with Nightingale ops. Checklist: conntrack dumps, NAT translation table snapshots, kernel/firmware versions, and iptables rules. If vendor firmware is implicated we need a mitigation plan. Need a maintenance window from Nightingale.

emma: I'll handle CI/blueprints validation and a small chaos test. Will simulate conntrack churn + asymmetric path using the network emulator. Also add a nightly regression that runs against the dedicated staging cluster. ETA: test branch in 5 days.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5188 "Nightingale peering & conntrack drift investigation"  assignee: network-ops  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5188

marta: Monitoring ask: create a Grafana dashboard + alerts for three signals: route_flap_rate, conntrack_reassoc_rate, and duplicate-forwarded-packet-rate. Alert conditions: route_flap_rate > 3/5m OR conntrack_reassoc_rate > 0.75% OR dup_forwarded_packets > 0.1% in 5m. @diego can you author the alert and panel?

diego: Yep. Draft queries: 
```
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="nightingale"}[5m]))
```
```
sum(rate(conntrack_reassoc_total{customer="nightingale"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(conntrack_total{customer="nightingale"}[5m])))
```
For duplicate packets we'll use the rtp/seq heuristics captured by edge-proxy and expose dup_forwarded_packets. Will add Slack notifications to #incidents and paging for critical.

priya: Nightingale runs two appliance models; one is on an EOL firmware (vendor 1.8) that vendor says "low priority" for NAT fixes. I'll record exact firmware versions in INC-5188 and propose a short-term pruning shim that runs on the appliance under customer consent. Also asking for a maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 PT.

emma: For CI we'll mock the vendor behavior so we don't touch customer infra. I will also add an acceptance test that replays the packet timing that reproduced the loop from the postmortem capture.

marta: Action items (added to postmortem doc):
1) diego  route suppress (20s) + export filter hardening + alerting (PR -> #PR-940)  ETA Wed EOD
2) priya  on-prem audit with Nightingale + firmware capture + vendor escalation (INC-5188)  ETA Mon next week
3) emma  CI/blueprints e2e & nightly chaos test  ETA Fri next week
4) add monitoring & dup-packet metric (owner: diego)  ETA Thu
5) customer coordination: priya & marta to confirm maintenance window and sign-off on any shim  ETA tomorrow

marta: Please update INC-5188 with milestones and paste PR/test links as they land. Short sync scheduled Tues 10:00 PT to confirm progress. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
